scientific_conclusion: The continuous Gaussian basis remains accurate, monotone on the sampled cube and boundary-clean, but it loses to the equal-budget regular lattice for every retained Fujifilm E-6 technical-source-derived operator. The GLUT0 advantage is therefore operator-family dependent rather than a universal compact-representation gain.
claim_ceiling: Representation evidence derived from first-party Fujifilm technical-source curves and a previously retained film-inspired operator; not real-film response, photographic appearance, stock calibration, preference or product evidence.
